method: X 新品挖掘日报 2026-08-10 · manual curation under STANDARD (evidence-as-bonus + 1c)
title: Magnitude — npm-installed local agent running local models for file/sheet/browser work (capability signal)
gap: The gap is the terminal itself: fully-local agents that do real work now exist behind a command line, with no ordinary-person wrapper.

zh.gap: 全本地干真活的能力已经有了，只是藏在命令行后面，还没人给普通人做一层壳。
zh.pain: 想要一个能读自己电脑里文件、填表格、点浏览器，还保证什么都不上传的助手——结果第一步是打开终端敲 npm。
zh.kill: 在乎隐私的人和会敲命令行的人高度重合；剩下的人更愿意图省事用云。
zh.move: 现在不是动手的时候，是记日期：三天内本地 agent 这根轴收到两个独立信号，这块地在升温。

pain: Its user is still a person who types npm — which is the whole distance between a capability and a product.
kill: Local-first keeps losing to cloud convenience, and the people who care about privacy overlap with the people who can already npm install.
move: Not to build as-is — the signal: paired with LocalAGI (logged 08-09), that's two independent local-agent signals in three days on the private-data × local axis (R0a). When the same capability knocks twice in a week, the turnkey home-agent wrapper moves closer.
